artDirection: Stylised low-poly, warm palette: red earth #9c4a2b, golden thatch #c9a45c, green grass #5d8f3e. One mango-tree style, one hut style, chitenje cloth tints via material color. No realistic/cartoon mixing.
pipeline: glTF/GLB + Draco/meshopt + KTX2/Basis (WebP fallback). Normalised scale (1 tile = 1m) and origin at feet. Shared material atlas where practical. Budget: <80k tris on screen, <150 draw calls, instancing for trees/grass/fences, LOD for detailed.
notes: Card/HUD icons are FROZEN (not in this manifest). This milestone ships procedural placeholders with a GLB-ready loader + fallback. External CC0/CC-BY binaries are mapped below as next-step downloads (licence verified on download page before import). No ripped assets.
